NUIProfileFAQAnswer: If you have more questions about the application and wish to know more, then keep reading the text below.
NUIProfileFAQ1Answer: Convoy jobs are awarded based on the skills of the convoy leader thats is currently searching for the jobs. The higher skills the convoy leader has, the better jobs will be available to the convoy.
NUIProfileFAQ2: Is there a bonus for completing a convoy job?
NUIProfileFAQ2Answer: Yes, there is a bonus for completing a convoy job. The bonus is based on the number of convoy members.
NUIProfileFAQ3: How do I get a truck?
NUIProfileFAQ3Answer: For Quick Jobs, you will be given a vehicle. For Freight Jobs, you will need to have your own truck or aquire it by other means.
NUIProfileFAQ4: How do I get a trailer?
NUIProfileFAQ4Answer: A trailer will be provided for you when you accept a Freight Job.
